command: WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); LABEL='Control by time' WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x=>x.innerText.includes(${JSON.stringify(process.env.LABEL)}));if(!b)throw new Error("button missing");b.click();return "clicked"})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails)process.exit(1);console.log(m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}' && sleep 1
